content: Twitch EventSub websocket: must reconnect if no event/keepalive within keepalive_timeout_seconds (10-600s, default configurable). On session_reconnect, connect to new reconnect_url and wait for session_welcome on the NEW socket before closing the old one -- old socket auto-disconnects after 30s grace period ('Reconnect grace time expired'); closing it too early misses in-flight events.
